method: Three alternating pairs, off/on, on/off, off/on. Same candidate binary and output base. Shut down before each synchronous clean for equal JVM history; clean starts the server, build uses that same PID. Verify graph count zero, empty execroot, deleted action_cache, and preserved external SkyCache publications. Time clean separately. No --expunge, --async, or --nouse_action_cache. Cache & Carry enabled for both.
limitations: OS page cache and WSL runtime history were not controlled. Existing external repository downloads were retained. The observed WSL boot preceded r2-on by approximately 56 seconds; restored-run analysis timing varied substantially.
SkyCache store was populated by the preceding experiment.
PSS/RSS are sampled process-tree memory, not host memory or filesystem cache.
Small sample; network transfer variability is uncontrolled.

protocol_events.event: Resume after successful r1 builds; harness had incorrectly required positive SkyCache hits. Zero hits are a valid measured outcome. Preserve original results and harness, continue remaining four runs unchanged.

postprocessing_events.event: Verified the old manifest mismatch at the Python pycache symlink and all 142366 replacement witnesses. Initial standalone decoder output is retained; it incorrectly represented an empty root-relative path as a dot. Correcting the read-only decoder resolved that artifact. No benchmark input changed.
